about.en: ArcBlock is a Web3 development platform combining decentralized identity, a blocklet application framework and its own ArcBlock mainnet. ABT is its utility token, issued as an ERC-20 at 0xB98d4C97425d9908E66E53A6fDf673ACcA0BE986 and also as a native asset on ArcBlock's chain; it is unrelated to Abbott Laboratories, which trades as ABT on the NYSE.
